Co-Op, AI-Driven Equation Discovery

Cambridge, MA USA; San Francisco, CA USA

Your Impact at LILA

The PS AI team sits at the intersection of Physical Sciences R&D and AI/ML. Lila runs high-throughput experiments across electrochemistry, formulations, and advanced materials, generating rich datasets that demand more than black-box models.

As a Co-Op focused on AI-driven equation discovery, you will develop and benchmark methods that extract interpretable governing equations directly from that data. Discovered equations reveal the underlying physics, make predictions explainable, and serve as mechanistic building blocks for digital twins and closed-loop optimization.

You will work alongside PS AI researchers and physical scientists, helping shape how Lila turns experimental data into scientific understanding at scale.

What You'll Be Building



- Build end-to-end equation discovery pipelines from preprocessing through candidate generation and validation
- Benchmark symbolic regression methods (SINDy, PDE-FIND, PySR, LLM-guided search) on Lila campaign data
- Apply equation discovery to live electrochemistry, formulation, and materials datasets
- Design evaluation harnesses measuring recovery rate, generalization, noise robustness, and physical consistency
- Embed discovered equations into surrogate models, physics-informed models, and experimental digital twins
- Translate open scientific questions into concrete problems with datasets, baselines, and success criteria
- Document and present findings across PS AI and domain science teams

What You'll Need To Succeed



- Pursuing a Master's or PhD in ML, CS, applied math, physics, materials science, or chemical engineering
- Strong Python skills with hands-on experience in PyTorch, JAX, or similar
- Experience applying machine learning to messy, real-world scientific or experimental data
- Solid grounding in linear algebra, calculus, and probability
- Comfort reading and implementing methods from ML research papers
- Ability to frame open-ended scientific questions as concrete ML tasks
- Clear communication across research, engineering, and physical science teams

Bonus Points For



- Working knowledge of symbolic or sparse regression methods (SINDy, PySR, PDE-FIND, or equivalent)
- Experience with LLM-guided or agentic symbolic regression (LLM-SR, SR-Scientist, or similar)
- Background in physics-informed ML, uncertainty quantification, or operator learning (PINNs, neural ODEs, FNO, DeepONet)
- Exposure to digital twin or closed-loop workflows: model calibration, active learning, Bayesian optimization
- Domain knowledge in electrochemistry, formulations, superconductors, or materials science

About LILA

Lila Sciences is building Scientific Superintelligence™ to solve humankind's greatest challenges. We believe science is the most inspiring frontier for AI. Rather than hard-coding expert knowledge into tools, LILA builds systems that can learn for themselves.

LILA combines advanced AI models with proprietary AI Science Factory™ instruments into an operating system for science that executes the entire scientific method autonomously, accelerating discovery at unprecedented speed, scale, and impact across medicine, materials, and energy. Learn more at www.lila.ai.

Guided by our core values of truth, trust, curiosity, grit, and velocity, we move with startup speed while tackling problems of historic importance. If this sounds like an environment you'd love to work in, even if you don't meet every qualification listed above, we encourage you to apply.

We’re All In

Lila Sciences is committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status.

Information you provide during your application process will be handled in accordance with our Candidate Privacy Policy.

A Note to Agencies

Lila Sciences does not accept unsolicited resumes from any source other than candidates. The submission of unsolicited resumes by recruitment or staffing agencies to Lila Sciences or its employees is strictly prohibited unless contacted directly by Lila Science’s internal Talent Acquisition team. Any resume submitted by an agency in the absence of a signed agreement will automatically become the property of Lila Sciences, and Lila Sciences will not owe any referral or other fees with respect thereto.

Teamwork makes the stream work.
 Roku is changing how the world watches TV
Roku is the #1 TV streaming platform in the U.S., Canada, and Mexico, and we've set our sights on powering every television in the world. Roku pioneered streaming to the TV. Our mission is to be the TV streaming platform that connects the entire TV ecosystem. We connect consumers to the content they love, enable content publishers to build and monetize large audiences, and provide advertisers unique capabilities to engage consumers.
From your first day at Roku, you'll make a valuable - and valued - contribution. We're a fast-growing public company where no one is a bystander. We offer you the opportunity to delight millions of TV streamers around the world while gaining meaningful experience across a variety of disciplines.
  
About the role 
Join Roku as an Engineering Intern and help build the agentic AI powering America’s #1 TV streaming platform. Roku reaches more than 100 million households worldwide, and we’re building production-grade AI agents across the products and platforms that serve them. We offer a paid 12-week internship, running from June to early September 2027. 
As an Engineering Intern, you’ll be assigned a scoped project with one of our engineering teams and matched to the team that best fits your skills and interests. You’ll work on real problems, such as agents that investigate failures, automate workflows, review or generate code, or help people make complex decisions. You’ll learn how to take an AI-powered idea from prototype to something people actually use, with a mentor alongside you and real ownership from day one. 
Our teams work across a variety of languages and technologies, from user interfaces and embedded software to platform services, automation and developer tooling, and embrace AI-assisted development to boost productivity and quality. 
 
What you’ll be doing 

- Own a well-defined project that contributes to the success of your team, from defining the problem through to delivery. 

- Build and test AI agents, copilots and automated workflows that perform meaningful, multi-step work. 

- Connect agents to trusted data, services and internal tools, using approaches such as retrieval, tool calling and orchestration, and help define what an agent may do on its own and when it should hand over to a person. 

- Evaluate your work: measure whether it does the job well, check its reliability and failure modes, and keep improving it based on real feedback. 

- Use AI coding tools every day to move faster, and validate everything they produce through testing, review and your own judgment. 

- Write clean, well-tested, documented code, take part in code reviews, and collaborate with engineers, mentors and cross-functional partners. 
 
Apply if 

- You are a penultimate-year student, or a final-year student planning to go on to a one-year master’s course. 

- You hold a permanent right to work in the UK. Unfortunately, we are unable to consider candidates on a student visa. 

- You are available for full-time work for the whole 12-week program, from June to early September. 

- You are keen to work with AI technologies and have previous experience building AI agents and automated workflows. 
 
We’re excited if you have 

- Currently enrolled in a degree program in Artificial Intelligence, Computer Science, Engineering or a related field. 

- Proficiency in Python, ideally with projects, open source or hackathon work beyond your coursework. 

- Hands-on experience building an LLM-powered or agentic system that does multi-step work, and ideally that someone other than you has used. 

- Familiarity with agentic patterns such as grounding and retrieval, tool use, orchestration, memory or conversational interfaces. 

- Sound engineering judgment: you check AI-generated work, understand how it can fail, and recognise when simple automation or a human review is the better approach. 

- A solid grounding in computer science fundamentals such as data structures, algorithms, and operating systems or networking concepts. 

- Strong problem-solving and technical communication abilities, and the ability to break down ambiguous problems and deliver in small steps. 

- Proactive mindset with passion for continuous learning and fast iteration. 
 
How will I use AI at Roku? 
At Roku, we don’t just use AI, we work with it. AI agents and smart tools help power drafts, analysis, and repetitive workflows, while our people bring direction, judgment, and accountability. We’re looking for curious, adaptable builders who can show how they’ve used AI or automation to move faster, raise the bar, and scale their impact. 
We value your AI skills if you have built fluency across the agentic engineering toolchain — coding harnesses like Claude Code or Cursor, MCP servers, custom skills, or agent frameworks.  You know how to drive an agent, verify its output, and ramp up on an unfamiliar codebase with an agent helping you. What's Roku's approach to hybrid working?
Roku fosters an inclusive and collaborative environment where teams generally work in the office Monday through Thursday. Fridays are generally flexible for remote work, except for employees whose specific roles or assigned office location require five days' a week attendance.
 What are some of the benefits?
Roku is committed to offering a diverse range of benefits as part of our compensation package to support our employees and their families. Our comprehensive benefits include global access to mental health and financial wellness support and resources. Local benefits include statutory and voluntary benefits which may include healthcare (medical, dental, and vision), life, accident, disability, commuter, and retirement options (401(k)/pension). Employees are supported in taking time off, in accordance with local leave policies and other personal needs to support their evolving work and life needs. It's important to note that not every benefit is available in all locations or for every role. For details specific to your location, please consult with your recruiter.
 Accommodations
Roku welcomes applicants of all backgrounds and provides reasonable accommodations and adjustments in accordance with applicable law. If you require reasonable accommodation at any point in the hiring process, please direct your inquiries to EmployeeRelations@Roku.com.
 What should I know about Roku's culture?
Roku is a great place for people who want to work in a fast-paced environment where everyone is focused on the company's success rather than their own. We try to surround ourselves with people who are great at their jobs, who are easy to work with, and who keep their egos in check. We appreciate a sense of humor. We believe a fewer number of very talented folks can do more for less cost than a larger number of less talented teams. We're independent thinkers with big ideas who act boldly, move fast and accomplish extraordinary things through collaboration and trust. In short, at Roku you'll be part of a company that's changing how the world watches TV. 
We have a unique culture that we are proud of. We think of ourselves primarily as problem-solvers, which itself is a two-part idea. We come up with the solution, but the solution isn't real until it is built and delivered to the customer. That penchant for action gives us a pragmatic approach to innovation, one that has served us well since 2002. 
To learn more about Roku, our global footprint, and how we've grown, visit https://www.weareroku.com/factsheet.
By providing your information, you acknowledge that you want Roku to contact you about job roles, that you have read Roku's Applicant Privacy Notice, and understand that Roku will use your information as described in that notice. If you do not wish to receive any communications from Roku regarding this role or similar roles in the future, you may unsubscribe at any time by emailing WorkforcePrivacy@Roku.com.
fit_why: Strong web and AI-agent overlap; team stack varies, some embedded work

WHAT MAKES US EPIC?

At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.

Being Epic means being a part of a team that continually strives to do right by our community and users. We’re constantly innovating to raise the bar of engine and game development.

PROGRAMMING - EPIC RESEARCH

What We Do

Epic Research conducts state-of-the-art research in machine learning, AI, character animation, and digital humans. We work with leading universities and product teams to bring new research into games like Fortnite, Unreal Engine, MetaHuman, and the tools creators use every day.

MACHINE LEARNING RESEARCH INTERNSHIP AT EPIC GAMES

What You'll Do

Epic Games is looking for current PhD students and recent PhD graduates (within 12 months of graduation) for paid research internships, working on state-of-the-art machine learning across our ecosystem. Epic makes Unreal Engine, which powers creative work across many industries, alongside some of the world's most popular games, including Fortnite and Rocket League. Through these products, ML research at Epic reaches millions of creators and players every day. AI is reshaping the games industry, and Epic Research - led by Lucia Specia and Michael Black - is at the center of that shift. We're looking for talented interns who want to be part of it.

In this role, you will

Work with our team of research scientists and programmers at the intersection of vision, language, speech processing, embodied agents, and game development to create state-of-the-art machine learning models in a range of areas - research topics of interest include:



- AI-backed interactive characters: LLMs for conversational characters, memory systems, automated evals, animation, etc.
- Game agents: vision-language-action, game-state agents, etc.
- 3D human and object tracking
- Reinforcement learning for embodied behavior
- Speech systems and conversational agents
- World building and game logic generation: video models, 2D->3D scene building, etc.
- AI-assisted game development, e.g. the next generation of Epic Developer Assistant for UE and UEFN
- Embodied and physical intelligence including human-object interaction
- Multi-modal diffusion models
- Player safety: AI-alignment, content moderation, etc.
- Improved user experience: personalised game recommendation, game representation, spam detection, etc.
- Content localization: (multimodal) translation, quality assurance, etc.
- Model distillation for realtime performance


What We're Looking For



- An ongoing or recently completed (within the last 12 months) PhD in Computer Science, Mathematics, AI or a related field
- A record of publication in top conferences/journals
- Experience implementing deep learning algorithms for problems in computer vision, natural language processing, or speech/audio processing
- Hands-on knowledge of state-of-the-art ML methods, such as Transformers, diffusion models, and reinforcement learning
- Experience with post-training foundation models, including SFT, preference training, and reinforcement learning
- Excellent AI coding and experimental programming skills
- Desirable: game development experience in either C++ or C#


Internship Details



- Duration: 5-12 months initially (depending on your location), with flexible start-dates throughout 2026/2027
- Hours: full-time (40 hours/week) or part-time (20 hours/week)
- Location: Select regions within North America and Europe
- Employment Authorization: You must hold an existing right to work in your given location for the full duration of the internship - visa sponsorship or support is unavailable for this role
- Publishing: Research by Epic interns is regularly published in top-tier conferences


This internship has a flexible start date in 2026/2027. Recruitment will be ongoing until teams find an ideal match. Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the posting location for the duration of the internship. For more information about Epic’s Early Career Program, visit epicgames.com/earlycareers. This is going to be Epic!

About Us

Epic Games is a leading interactive entertainment company. For over 30 years we've been making award-winning games and engine technology that empowers others to make visually stunning games and 3D content that bring environments to life like never before. Epic's award-winning Unreal Engine technology not only provides game developers the ability to build high-fidelity, interactive experiences for PC, console, mobile, and VR, it is also a tool being embraced by content creators across a variety of industries such as media and entertainment, automotive, and architectural design. As we continue to build our Engine technology and develop remarkable games, we strive to build teams of world-class talent.

Like what you hear? Come be a part of something Epic!

Epic Games deeply values diverse teams and an inclusive work culture, and we are proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. Learn more about our Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) Policy here.

Note to Recruitment Agencies: Epic does not accept any unsolicited resumes or approaches from any unauthorized third party (including recruitment or placement agencies) (i.e., a third party with whom we do not have a negotiated and validly executed agreement). We will not pay any fees to any unauthorized third party. Further details on these matters can be found here.
fit_why: Requires PhD and publications; candidate is an undergrad with no research record

jd:
At Tecsys, the software we deliver keeps hospitals, pharmacies and distributors supplied with what they need, when they need it. Every role here connects to that outcome.

Why This Role Matters 

As an Intern Developer, you will join the team behind our internal test automation platform, a team at the heart of how Tecsys catches problems before they reach customers. You'll build features across the platform's React front end and Python services, write and maintain automated tests, and help keep CI/CD pipelines running on every merge request. Your work helps our developers ship with confidence, so the software hospitals and distributors rely on keeps working.

What You'll Be Part Of

Tecsys is trusted by mission-critical organizations in healthcare and distribution to power resilient, efficient and secure supply chains. We are a global provider of cloud-based, AI-driven software, publicly traded on the Toronto Stock Exchange (TSX: TCS).

Three values guide how we work. We earn trust daily by valuing the customer and acting with integrity. We build each other up by recognizing individual strengths and working as one team. And we explore boldly by staying curious and adapting for success.

You'll join a culture driven by curiosity, continuous learning, and people who challenge what's possible.

What You'll Do



- Build and enhance features for our internal test automation platform, across the React front end and Python (Flask/FastAPI) backend services and APIs 
- Fix bugs and refactor existing code, writing pytest unit tests alongside your changes 
- Contribute to test-result reporting features such as dashboards, trends and run-to-run comparisons 
- Use AI coding assistants (Claude Code, Kiro) in daily development, reviewing and testing what they produce 
- Do first-pass code reviews on merge requests, and maintain CI/CD pipelines so automated tests run on every merge request 
- Build and maintain automated API, UI and unit regression tests, including turning Playwright recordings into stable, maintainable UI tests 
- Investigate failures, report defects with clear reproduction steps, and document features, test coverage and how to run the suites 


Requirements

What You Bring 

You do not need to match every line below. If most of it describes you, apply:



- Final year of a bachelor's or master's program in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related field 
- Available for a placement of at least two terms 
- Solid knowledge of Python and React, with the ability to read and understand existing code 
- Experience with Git and merge/pull request workflows 
- Hands-on use of an AI coding assistant such as Claude Code, Kiro or Copilot 
- Good attention to detail and clear written communication 
- Previous co-op terms with other companies are an asset 

We foster an inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued, respected, and empowered to thrive.

If this role fits what you are looking for, apply today. If you are not actively searching but want to hear more, we are glad to talk

Apply today and discover what you could build, solve, and achieve with Tecsys!
fit_why: Full-stack React/Python internship matches his core stack and experience
